units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:11">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> (ref. to <he>גת החפר</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 14:25">I Kings XIV, 25</cite>) <he>אילין ג׳ דציפורין</he> that is G. near Sepph.

Koh. R. to IX, 10 the lamentations over the death of Rabbi at Sepph. were heard עד גובבתה וכ׳ (some ed. גובתתה, גובח׳, corr. acc.) as far as Gob., a distance of three mil; ib. to VII, 11 גופתתא; Y. Kil. V, 32ᵇ top לגו פפתה (combine in one w.); Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ top לגו פתתה (corr. acc.). [Y. Snh. VII, end, 25ᵈ גופתא דציפורין; Y. Ber. III, 6ᵃ bot.; Y. Naz. VII, 56ᵃ top גופנא דציפ׳ (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 7:2:11">Y. Shek. VII, 50ᶜ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 2:5:2">Y. Succ. II, 53ᵃ</cite> top <he>גופתא</he>—prob. the same as <he>גובב׳</he>.] V. <cite ref="C00294"><he>גּוּבְתָּא</he></cite>.
